splitOff.why: It changes the journey's address-return route and the handshake token it checks, which live in frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/address-return and frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/ins-handshake.js, and is proven by tests:tests/animals/e2e/features/address-book/addresses-add-handshake.spec.ts. All three are touches of the address-book theme, which already holds the rest of the add handshake and return set (req-634 to req-640, req-643, req-646). The refusals it asks for (missing, reused or mismatched token, and an address id looked up outside the signed-in organisation's own book) cannot be built without changing that theme's code.

The party edit page's heading, browser title and journey strip are already built; the only delta the requirement records is the consignor's caption, which comes from the shared party title copy in frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy and is proven by frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/fit/party-edit.fit.spec.js. Both are touches of the consignment-parties theme, which owns the party roles and their titles. The plants party edit page already captions with the party's own title, so nothing is left in party-edit itself.

alreadyCovered.why: The existing deferred row for the parked address search already covers it. A deferred row covers its requirements, and a row built or set aside may not be rewritten, so no new row is drafted and it is not handed to a split-off branch.

notes: The area holds 79 requirements. Every one about the copied address a notification holds (copy semantics, the party edit page's fields, rules and messages, rule-breaking copies blocking submit, and the copy frozen after submission: req-679, req-681, req-683 to req-698) is adopted as already met, so none takes a row. req-629, req-1961 and req-1962 are out of scope. Thirteen adopted new or change requirements in the area are already held by themes split off early (req-643, req-646, req-647, req-648, req-650, req-651, req-660, req-664, req-670, req-678, req-1958 and req-2186 by address-book, req-680 by overview-and-review, req-1831 by consignment-parties), so they are left out of the area's work. What was left to build is the two requirements in splitOff, whose code a split-off theme owns, and the five the existing deferred address-search row already covers. The area therefore drafts no row.
